name: WavyStay — Owner/Co-Host CSV Import to GHL

parameters.content:
## WavyStay Owner/Co-Host Import — Setup

**Before running:**
1. Run the CSV cleanup pass first (split Tier → Tier Rank + Data Quality Flag, swap City/State, drop `Listing URL.1`). This workflow assumes an already-cleaned CSV — it does not do that cleanup itself.
2. Create an n8n credential: **Header Auth**, header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your GHL Private Integration Token>`. Attach it to every HTTP Request node below (placeholder credential id `REPLACE_WITH_GHL_CREDENTIAL`).
3. Open the **Normalize Row** node and edit the `cfg` object at the top of its code — that's the single place all workflow-specific IDs live, no separate node or host env vars needed:
   - `locationId` and `pipelineId` are already filled in (WavyStay's "WS-Owner Lifecycle" pipeline).
   - `stageColdLeadId` is blank — find the "Cold Lead" stage id (GHL doesn't expose it in the UI; use the Network tab on the pipeline's Stages page, or `GET /opportunities/pipelines?locationId=...`) and paste it in. Until then, new opportunities land in the pipeline's default stage instead of "Cold Lead" specifically — `Create Opportunity` only sends `pipelineStageId` when this is filled in, so a blank value doesn't error, it just skips the field.
   - The 10 `cf*` fields (Contact: Business Unit, Referral Source, Phone 2/3, Email 2; Opportunity: Tier Rank, Close Score, Current Manager, Pitch Angle, Listing URL) are also blank — each is skipped when empty, but fill in the 5 Opportunity ones for real: they're the entire reason this workflow exists instead of GHL's native importer.

**Running it:** open the "Upload CSV" node and use the Test step URL it shows to open the upload form in your browser, then pick the cleaned CSV file there — nothing needs to exist on the n8n host's filesystem. Activate the workflow (top-right toggle) once to get a stable production form URL for repeat runs.

**Why it's built this way:**
- Tier, Close Score, Current Manager, Pitch Angle and Listing URL live on the **Opportunity**, never the Contact — so an owner's 2nd/3rd listing never overwrites another listing's prioritization data on a shared Contact.
- "Create Opportunity" sets customFields in the *same* POST (GHL's v2 API accepts customFields on create), so there's no separate update call that can fail independently and leave an opportunity with blank fields.
- Contact lookup checks phone AND email (`/contacts/search/duplicate`) before creating anything — an owner's repeat listing reuses the existing Contact ID instead of creating a duplicate contact.
- Every row ends at exactly one of 6 terminal nodes (2 success, 4 failure) so a bad row is visible after a run instead of silently vanishing or halting the whole batch.
- A row with neither Phone 1 nor Email 1 is flagged immediately ("Row Failed - Missing Contact Info") before any API call — GHL's search endpoint requires at least one identifier and would otherwise reject it with a 400.
- All 4 GHL HTTP calls retry up to 3x (1s apart) before giving up, so a one-off network blip (e.g. a connection timeout) doesn't permanently fail a row that would have succeeded on a second try.
- All 4 GHL HTTP calls use n8n's built-in Batching option (1 item per batch, 1000ms between batches) so rows are sent to GHL one at a time with a real gap between them, avoiding 429 rate-limit errors on larger CSVs. (An earlier version used a Wait node for this, but a Wait node only pauses once for the whole set of items, not per row — Batching is the correct mechanism and is what GHL's own 429 error message points you toward.)
- CSV headers assumed by "Normalize Row": Owner Name, Phone 1-3, Email 1-2, City, State, Referral Source, Listing Title, Listing URL, Tier Rank, Data Quality Flag, Close Score, Current Manager, Pitch Angle. Edit that node's `get('...')` keys if your cleaned CSV uses different header text.

parameters.formDescription: Upload the cleaned owner/co-host CSV. Expected headers: Owner Name, Phone 1-3, Email 1-2, City, State, Referral Source, Listing Title, Listing URL, Tier Rank, Data Quality Flag, Close Score, Current Manager, Pitch Angle.

assignments.value: Row has neither Phone 1 nor Email 1 - cannot search or create a GHL contact for it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ pipelineId: $('Normalize Row').item.json.pipelineId, locationId: $('Normalize Row').item.json.locationId, name: $('Normalize Row').item.json.listingTitle, status: 'open', contactId: $json.contactId, ...($('Normalize Row').item.json.stageColdLeadId ? { pipelineStageId: $('Normalize Row').item.json.stageColdLeadId } : {}), customFields: $('Normalize Row').item.json.opportunityCustomFields }) }}
